point_screen.criteria: Both initial hands within0.18m of height-specific reference targets; finite; root>0.65m; drift<0.45m; boxheight within0.08m; foot support and hand proximity observed in both independent scenes at each height.
point_screen.limitations: Three sampled heights, finite short PD screen; not continuous-height proof, long-term policy success or 5degree guarantee. RSI excludes clips with no surviving poses; all AMP experts retained.
